document.description: Lawful Permanent Resident status in the United States grants visa-free or simplified entry privileges to multiple international jurisdictions.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US Permanent Resident Card (Green Card) + valid passport
unlocks.notes: US permanent residents are exempt from the eTA requirement and can enter visa-free with their Green Card and passport.

unlocks.conditions: Valid, unexpired US Permanent Resident Card + valid passport
unlocks.notes: Foreign nationals with lawful permanent resident status in the US do not require a Mexican tourist visa for stays up to 180 days.

unlocks.conditions: US Permanent Resident Card valid for at least 6 months
unlocks.notes: US Green Card holders are exempt from consular entry visa requirements for tourism stays up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US Permanent Resident Card presented upon arrival
unlocks.notes: Permanent residents of the United States can enter Belize visa-free or obtain entry clearance on arrival for tourism up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US Permanent Resident Card + valid travel document
unlocks.notes: Holders of valid permanent residence permits from the US may enter Georgia without a visa for an aggregate stay of up to 90 days within any 180-day period.

unlocks.conditions: Valid, unexpired US Permanent Resident Card
unlocks.notes: Foreign nationals who hold a valid permanent residence permit issued by the US can enter Albania without a visa for up to 90 days within 180 days.
Holders of permanent residence permits in the United States may enter and stay in Montenegro visa-free for up to 30 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid US Green Card + valid passport
unlocks.notes: Any person who has legal residence in the US can enter the Dominican Republic with a Tourist Card without needing a consular visa.

unlocks.conditions: US Permanent Resident Card valid for at least 6 months + passport
unlocks.notes: Executive Decree exempts foreign nationals holding permanent residence in the US from requiring a tourist visa for stays up to 30 days.
